Classify junctions by orientation and complex event

Source: R/geom-junction.R
annotate_junctions.Rd

Adds two columns for coloring geom_junction():

  • sv_class: orientation from the breakpoint strands, "DEL-like" (+/-), "DUP-like" (-/+), "INV-h2h" (+/+), or "INV-t2t" (-/-), for both cis and trans junctions. Use with scale_colour_sv_class().

  • event: the JaBbA complex event the junction belongs to, from the event columns (chromothripsis, chromoplexy, templated_insertion, rigma, pyrgo, tyfonas, ecdna, bfb), or "Simple"; and event_id with the event label, e.g. "CPX-4". Use with scale_colour_jabba_event().

Usage

annotate_junctions(junctions)

Arguments

junctions

Data frame of junctions with strand1 and strand2 columns and optionally JaBbA event columns, e.g. from devgru::read_bedpe_file(output_type = "dt") of a JaBbA junctions.bedpe.

Value

junctions as a data frame with sv_class, event, and event_id added
